# CHAT ROOT CAUSE

The chat loading defect had **three root causes** in `expo/src/modules/chat/screens/ChatScreen.tsx`:

1. **Visible jump on open:** The `onContentSizeChange` and `onLayout` callbacks called `scrollToBottom()` with animation on every content size change, including the initial load. This caused old messages to flash briefly before scrolling to the latest message.

2. **Forced scroll while reading history:** The `useEffect` watching `messages.length` called `scrollToBottom(true)` unconditionally whenever new messages arrived — even when the user was reading older messages. This yanked the user to the bottom against their will.

3. **No scroll position tracking:** The FlatList had no `onScroll` handler, so the app had no way to know whether the user was near the bottom (where auto-scroll is appropriate) or reading history (where it is not).

- Modified `onContentSizeChange`: only scrolls when `isNearBottomRef.current === true`
